verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer portal has a featured MCP page describing an official server that lets AI assistants interact with the Anytype API through natural language, and a probe confirmed the page exists. The server sits on top of the local API bundled with the desktop app. Missing for 10: detail on the server's tools and setup steps, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and clarity on whether it works without the desktop app running.
